utm_prospective_review.challenge: Prefer NO_CHANGE while the US URL Test completes. The reported DE Test finds the landing page and emits one instance of each automatic UTM key, so duplicate parameters are not reproduced. Microsoft recommends URL Test when manual suffixes coexist with automatic tagging; coexistence alone does not require deletion. Record the observed automatic campaign-name/ad-group values and their mapping to the two saved ads instead of claiming the manual campaign/ad identifiers reach analytics. Two suffix-clearing Saves currently offer optional configuration cleanup, with no demonstrated attribution gain. Reconsider only if paired tests reveal a mismatch or an explicit tracking requirement needs different values. Any future proposal must freeze the two existing ad IDs, exact before suffixes and rollback, preserve account options and legacy campaigns, and verify assembled URLs and saved ad state. No external Save is approved without an exact action contract; native Test is not a paid click or purchase-ingestion test.
utm_prospective_review.de_test_provenance: Parent message reports passing landing-page test, automatic campaign-name/ad-group/term values and no duplicate keys. No test receipt was supplied in this bounded review; this is not independent test verification.
